Name: REINFORCE_PARAM_WEAPON_ST
Description: Defines weapon upgrade levels. A weapon uses the row Reinforce Type ID + its upgrade level (the last two digits of the weapon ID). The row scales the weapon's attack, scaling and guard values at that level, and gives the materials and rune cost of the upgrade to that level. Rates are multipliers: 1 leaves the weapon's value unchanged.

Fields.Name: Damage %: Physical
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's base physical attack at this level.

Fields.Name: Damage %: Magic
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's base magic attack at this level.

Fields.Name: Damage %: Fire
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's base fire attack at this level.

Fields.Name: Damage %: Lightning
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's base lightning attack at this level.

Fields.Name: Damage %: Stamina
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's base stamina attack (stamina damage dealt to a guarding target) at this level.

Fields.Name: Damage %: Poise
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's poise damage at this level. Retail: always 1.

Fields.Name: Poise Durability
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game (the weapon's own poise durability isn't read either). Retail: always 1.

Fields.Name: Correction %: STR
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's Strength scaling at this level. An affinity's scaling override (AttackElementCorrectParam) is multiplied by it too. 0 removes the scaling: retail crossbow and ballista rows use 0.

Fields.Name: Correction %: DEX
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's Dexterity scaling at this level. An affinity's scaling override (AttackElementCorrectParam) is multiplied by it too. 0 removes the scaling: retail Heavy and crossbow/ballista rows use 0.

Fields.Name: Correction %: INT
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's Intelligence scaling at this level. An affinity's scaling override (AttackElementCorrectParam) is multiplied by it too. 0 removes the scaling: retail crossbow and ballista rows use 0.

Fields.Name: Correction %: FTH
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's Faith scaling at this level. An affinity's scaling override (AttackElementCorrectParam) is multiplied by it too. 0 removes the scaling: retail crossbow and ballista rows use 0.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption %: Physical
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's physical guard damage negation at this level. Retail: 0.95 on some affinities, otherwise 1.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption %: Magic
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's magic guard damage negation at this level. Retail: 0.95 to 1.25 depending on affinity.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption %: Fire
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's fire guard damage negation at this level. Retail: 0.95 to 1.25 depending on affinity (highest on Fire rows).

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption %: Lightning
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's lightning guard damage negation at this level. Retail: 0.95 to 1.25 depending on affinity.

Fields.Name: Guard Resist %: Poison
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's poison guard resistance (how much buildup is blocked when guarding) at this level. Retail: 0.95 on some affinities, otherwise 1.

Fields.Name: Guard Resist %: Scarlet Rot
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's scarlet rot guard resistance at this level. Retail: 0.95 on some affinities, otherwise 1.

Fields.Name: Guard Resist %: Blood Loss
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's blood loss guard resistance at this level. Retail: 0.95 on some affinities, otherwise 1.

Fields.Name: Guard Resist %: Death Blight
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's death blight guard resistance at this level. Retail: 0.95 on some affinities, otherwise 1.

Fields.Name: Guard Boost %
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's guard boost (stamina defence when guarding) at this level. Retail: 1 to 1.32.

Fields.Name: Behavior SpEffect [1] Offset
Fields.Description: Added to the weapon's Behavior SpEffect 1 ID at this level, so each level can use its own SpEffect row. Retail: Blood rows add the level (1-25).

Fields.Name: Behavior SpEffect [2] Offset
Fields.Description: Added to the weapon's Behavior SpEffect 2 ID at this level. Retail: Cold and Poison rows add the level (1-25).

Fields.Name: Behavior SpEffect [3] Offset
Fields.Description: Added to the weapon's Behavior SpEffect 3 ID at this level. Retail: always 0.

Fields.Name: Passive SpEffect [1] Offset
Fields.Description: Added to the weapon's Passive SpEffect 1 ID at this level. Retail: always 0.

Fields.Name: Passive SpEffect [2] Offset
Fields.Description: Added to the weapon's Passive SpEffect 2 ID at this level. Retail: always 0.

Fields.Name: Passive SpEffect [3] Offset
Fields.Description: Added to the weapon's Passive SpEffect 3 ID at this level. Retail: always 0.

Fields.Name: Reinforcement Material Set Offset
Fields.Description: Added to the weapon's Reinforcement Material Set ID to pick the EquipMtrlSetParam row of materials needed to upgrade to this level. Retail: rows use their own level, so the regular set asks 2 Smithing Stone [1] for +1 and an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone for +25.

Fields.Name: Matchmaking Upgrade Level
Fields.Description: The level this row counts as on the regular 0-25 scale. The game records the highest value among the weapons the player has obtained and uses it (capped at 25) for multiplayer matchmaking against GameSystemCommonParam's weapon-level limits. Retail: equal to the level on regular rows; somber rows map +1 to +10 onto 2, 5, 7, 10, 12, 15, 17, 20, 22 and 25.

Fields.Name: Damage %: Holy
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's base holy attack at this level.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption %: Holy
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's holy guard damage negation at this level. Retail: 0.95 to 1.25 depending on affinity.

Fields.Name: Correction %: ARC
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's Arcane scaling at this level. An affinity's scaling override (AttackElementCorrectParam) is multiplied by it too. 0 removes the scaling: retail crossbow and ballista rows use 0.

Fields.Name: Guard Resist %: Frostbite
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's frostbite guard resistance at this level. Retail: 0.95 on some affinities, otherwise 1.

Fields.Name: Reinforce Price Rate
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's Reinforcement Price: the rune cost of the upgrade to this level is that price times this rate, rounded down.

Fields.Name: Base Change Price Rate
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: always 1.

Fields.Name: Max Ash of War Rank
Fields.Description: An Ash of War can be applied only when its rank is not above this value (on weapons whose Ash of War Type allows one). Retail: always 0, as is every Ash of War's rank.
Padding.

Fields.Name: Guard Resist %: Sleep
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's sleep guard resistance at this level. Retail: 0.95 on some affinities, otherwise 1.

Fields.Name: Guard Resist %: Madness
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's madness guard resistance at this level. Retail: 0.95 on some affinities, otherwise 1.

Fields.Name: Damage %: BaseAtk
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the flat attack that AtkParam rows with Is Base Attack Added set add on top of the weapon's (typically Ash of War attacks), at this level. Retail: 1 at +0 rising to 4 at +25 on regular rows.
